newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil 1996 soluble coffee exports fall from 1995.
newsitem.headline: Brazil 1996 soluble coffee exports fall from 1995.

text.p: Exports of Brazilian instant coffee totaled 58,000 tonnes in 1996 against 60,365 tonnes in 1995, a drop of 3.9 percent, said Brazilian Soluble Coffee Industry Association (ABICS).
Revenue was 9.98 percent lower at $430 million against $477.7 million in 1995.
Russia was the largest importer of Brazilian coffee, buying 26,362 tonnes in the last 12 months which represented 45.4 percent of total sales.
Total exports in 1997 are expected to drop 0.86 percent to 57,500 tonnes and total revenue to fall 10.77 percent to $383.7 million next year.
"We are expecting lower revenue because of an anticipated drop in world prices due to new production of soluble coffee such as in Vietnam," said ABICS president Sergio Coimbra
